title: Salestrics | All-in-One CRM & Revenue Workspace for Startups
excerpt: CRM, mail, docs, and support for startup revenue teams — one workspace. Hosted MCP so Cursor and Claude work on live pipeline data.
content_html:
Salestrics MCP is live — connect Cursor, Claude Desktop, and VS Code to live CRM & mail.

All-in-one CRM & revenue workspace
for startups — with agent-ready MCP.

Salestrics connects pipeline, inbox, documents, meetings, support, and AI in one workspace — then exposes it through a hosted Model Context Protocol server. Built for startup GTM teams; your agents work in Cursor and Claude on the same live records.

  • 163 MCP toolsCRM, mail & ops
  • One workspacePipeline to support
  • Live platformNo CSV exports
  • See Platform Updates
  • Startup CRM buyer guide

Inside Salestrics Live product

See the whole relationship

Everything belongs to the account

Deals, messages, proposals, meetings, invoices, and support history stay together from first touch onward.

Know the next move

Your team starts with context

Open an account and see what happened, who owns the next step, and what needs attention without chasing an update.

Agents meet the same data

MCP on the live workspace

Connect Cursor, Claude, or VS Code with org-scoped keys — agents read and act on current pipeline, mail, and workspace records, not stale exports.

Why connected context matters

01 / Capture

Turn activity into a living pipeline

Track leads, contacts, and deals while email and meetings add context to the account.

02 / Create

Build the work beside the deal

Create proposals, documents, and spreadsheets where the customer context already lives.

03 / Understand

Give agents and AI the full picture

Assistant in the browser, MCP for Cursor and Claude — summaries, answers, and actions grounded in current pipeline and account activity.

04 / Operate

Connect revenue to the work

Keep invoices, reporting, and operational workflows attached to the records that created them.

05 / Collaborate

Keep decisions close to context

Message teammates, run meetings, and share updates without sending the team to another tool.

06 / Retain

Carry context into support

Resolve customer issues with the relationship history visible, then share wins and updates in Orbit!

Explore the full platform

Newsletter

Stay in the loop

Launch notes and product updates from the team.

Get started

Run your revenue loop — and connect your agents

Start with CRM, docs, AI, email, and support in one connected workspace — no credit card. Create an MCP API key in Admin and point Cursor or Claude at your live data. Questions? Talk to us or see pricing.

content_html_zh:
Salestrics MCP 已上线 — 将 Cursor、Claude Desktop 和 VS Code 连接到实时 CRM 和邮件。

面向初创公司的一体化 CRM 和收入工作区 — 具有代理就绪的 MCP。

Salestrics 将管道、收件箱、文档、会议、支持和 AI 连接到一个工作区中，然后通过托管的模型上下文协议服务器将其公开。 专为初创 GTM 团队打造；您的代理人在 Cursor 和 Claude 中工作，处理相同的实时记录。

  • 163 MCP 工具CRM、邮件和运营
  • 一个工作区支持管道
  • 直播平台无CSV导出
  • 查看平台更新
  • 初创公司 CRM 买家指南

内部 Salestrics 实时产品

查看整个关系

一切都属于账户

交易、消息、提案、会议、发票和支持历史记录从第一次接触开始就保留在一起。

知道下一步行动

您的团队从背景开始

开设一个账户，看看发生了什么，谁拥有下一步，以及需要注意什么，而无需追逐更新。

代理商满足相同数据

实时工作区中的 MCP

将 Cursor、Claude 或 VS Code 与组织范围内的键连接起来 — 代理读取当前管道、邮件和工作区记录（而不是过时的导出）并对其执行操作。

为什么关联上下文很重要

01 / Capture

将活动变成一条活生生的管道

跟踪潜在客户、联系人和交易，同时电子邮件和会议为客户添加上下文。

02 / Create

在交易之外开展工作

在客户背景已经存在的地方创建提案、文档和电子表格。

03 / Understand

为代理和人工智能提供全面的信息

浏览器中的助手、Cursor 和 Claude 的 MCP — 基于当前管道和帐户活动的摘要、答案和操作。

04 / Operate

将收入与工作联系起来

将发票、报告和操作工作流程附加到创建它们的记录中。

05 / Collaborate

让决策贴近实际情况

向团队成员发送消息、召开会议并共享更新，而无需将团队发送到其他工具。

06 / Retain

将上下文纳入支持

通过可见的关系历史记录解决客户问题，然后在 Orbit 中分享胜利和更新！

开始使用

运行您的收入循环——并连接您的代理商

从一个互联工作空间中的 CRM、文档、AI、电子邮件和支持开始 - 无需信用卡。 在管理中创建 MCP API 密钥，并将光标或 Claude 指向您的实时数据。 问题？ 与我们联系或查看定价。
